name: Empty-state outcome headline with one CTA
problem: Empty library and launcher surfaces either offer no action or overwhelm users with multiple competing CTAs.
worksWhen: The empty state has a clear outcome headline and one primary action
The surface is a first-visit or depleted library rather than an error panel
failsWhen: Multiple CTAs compete for attention on the empty canvas
The headline describes absence instead of the outcome the user will achieve

name: Persistent non-modal scan progress
problem: Long-running library scans or imports either block navigation with modal progress or hide status so users cannot tell whether work continues.
worksWhen: Scan or import work can continue while the user browses other areas
Progress is visible but non-blocking on the library surface
failsWhen: Progress is shown only in a modal that freezes navigation
Status disappears after start with no persistent indicator
